zh: 今天天气冷，我进屋后立刻脱掉外套。
old_en: As soon as I got in the house, I took off my coat because it was cold today.
new_en: It was cold today, so I took off my coat as soon as I got in the house.

zh: 你可以先等我，我们一起上车。
old_en: You can wait for me first, then we can get in the car together.
new_en: You can wait for me first, and then we can get in the car together.

zh: 因为下雨了，我急着进屋躲雨。
old_en: Because it started raining, I hurried to get in the house to avoid the rain.
new_en: It started raining, so I hurried to get in the house to stay dry.

zh: 我进站时发现车票忘带了。
old_en: When I got in the station, I realized I had forgotten my ticket.
new_en: When I got into the station, I realized I had forgotten my ticket.
